newsitem.title: USA: General Instrument gets cable modem order.
newsitem.headline: General Instrument gets cable modem order.

text.p: General Instrument Corp said Tuesday its Next Level Satellite Data Networks Group received a commitment from Adelphia Communications for the purchase of 50,000 SURFboard cable modems and the associated network.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Adelphia will use the modems to provide its high-speed Internet service, called Powerlink, over the cable TV network to subscribers' personal computers in seven markets, General Instrument said.
The SURFboard modems allow users to download data via cable, but requests for data are made over telephone lines.
